description: Pedagogical example catalog for agents, docs, and smoke tests. Canonical examples teach typed Axiograph surfaces; debug export-era scripts are deliberately not the primary route.

examples.title: Minimal typed family ontology
commands: cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p axiograph-cli -- check validate examples/Family.axi

examples.title: Family paths and HoTT-flavored witnesses
commands: cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p axiograph-cli -- check validate examples/family/FamilyHoTT.axi

examples.title: Runtime theory graph and rewrite surface
commands: cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p axiograph-cli -- discover theory-graph examples/ontology/OntologyRewrites.axi --out build/examples/ontology_rewrites_theory_graph.json

examples.title: Schema/category evolution and transport
commands: cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p axiograph-cli -- check validate examples/ontology/SchemaEvolution.axi

examples.title: Supply-chain path semantics
commands: cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p axiograph-cli -- cert query examples/manufacturing/SupplyChainHoTT.axi --lang axql 'select ?to where name("RawMetal_A") -Flow-> ?to limit 10' --out build/examples/supply_chain_query_cert.json

examples.title: Regulated production line with business and implementation surfaces
commands: ./examples/behavior_cases/run_regulated_release_flow.sh

cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p axiograph-example-industrial --bin axiograph-industrial-example -- run-regulated-seed --axi examples/industrial/RegulatedProductionLine.axi --cache-root build/examples/industrial --run-id demo-001 --created-at-unix-secs 1713810000 --json

cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p axiograph-cli -- discover behavior-case examples/industrial/RegulatedProductionLine.axi --request examples/behavior_cases/regulated_ship_release.json --overlay examples/behavior_cases/regulated_ship_release_overlay.json --out build/examples/regulated_ship_release_behavior_case_report.json

examples.title: DDD/fDDD software authoring from typed overlay tools
commands: ./examples/software_authoring/run_authoring_flow.sh
./examples/software_authoring/run_codegen_examples.sh
./examples/software_authoring/run_definition_queries.sh
cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p axiograph-cli -- check validate examples/software_authoring/OrderFulfillmentDomain.axi
cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p axiograph-cli -- check theory examples/software_authoring/OrderFulfillmentDomain.axi --closure-tier finite_fragment
cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p axiograph-cli -- authoring tool-specs --out build/examples/software_authoring/tool_specs.json
cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p axiograph-cli -- authoring lsp-capabilities --out build/examples/software_authoring/lsp_capabilities.json
cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p axiograph-cli -- authoring integration-manifest --out build/examples/software_authoring/integration_manifest.json

cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p axiograph-cli -- authoring codegen-plan --overlay examples/software_authoring/order_fulfillment_tooling_overlay.json --out build/examples/software_authoring/codegen_plan.json

cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p axiograph-cli -- discover overlay-check examples/software_authoring/OrderFulfillmentDomain.axi --overlay examples/software_authoring/order_fulfillment_tooling_overlay.json

cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p axiograph-cli -- discover define examples/software_authoring/OrderFulfillmentDomain.axi --overlay examples/software_authoring/order_fulfillment_tooling_overlay.json --prompt "define the shipment eligibility business rule" --kind-hint business_rule --include-queries

cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p axiograph-cli -- discover behavior-case examples/software_authoring/OrderFulfillmentDomain.axi --request examples/software_authoring/order_fulfillment_behavior_case.json --overlay examples/software_authoring/order_fulfillment_tooling_overlay.json --out build/examples/order_fulfillment_behavior_case_report.json

cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p axiograph-cli -- check software-coverage examples/software_authoring/OrderFulfillmentDomain.axi --behavior-case examples/software_authoring/order_fulfillment_behavior_case.json --overlay examples/software_authoring/order_fulfillment_tooling_overlay.json --out build/examples/order_fulfillment_software_coverage.json

cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p axiograph-example-software-authoring --bin axiograph-software-authoring-example -- continuous-check --behavior-report build/examples/order_fulfillment_behavior_case_report.json --repo-root . --out build/examples/order_fulfillment_example_crate_continuous_coverage.json

examples.title: Subscription billing codegen from typed ontology overlays
commands: EXAMPLE_ID=subscription_billing ./examples/software_authoring/run_codegen_examples.sh

cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p axiograph-cli -- discover behavior-case examples/software_authoring/SubscriptionBillingDomain.axi --request examples/software_authoring/subscription_billing_behavior_case.json --overlay examples/software_authoring/subscription_billing_tooling_overlay.json --out build/examples/subscription_billing_behavior_case_report.json

examples.title: Process-control codegen and coverage over simulator/HMI/PLC surfaces
commands: EXAMPLE_ID=process_control ./examples/software_authoring/run_codegen_examples.sh

cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p axiograph-cli -- discover behavior-case examples/software_authoring/ProcessControlDomain.axi --request examples/software_authoring/process_control_behavior_case.json --overlay examples/software_authoring/process_control_tooling_overlay.json --out build/examples/process_control_behavior_case_report.json

examples.title: Scientific ontology and measurement semantics
commands: cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p axiograph-cli -- check validate examples/physics/PhysicsOntology.axi

examples.title: Proto/API semantics lowered to canonical ontology
commands: cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p axiograph-cli -- check validate examples/proto/ProtoApiSemantics.axi
